profile.name: Emily Anderson
profile.bio: Warehouse temp worker with big plans and almost no cushion.
profile.backstory: Emily Anderson is a 36-year-old warehouse temp worker who lives alone. Her income is unpredictable, debt payments take more than half of it, and she has about two weeks of expenses saved. She has $3,000 she wants to grow to start a small business within about a year. She says she is happy to take real risk for higher growth. But in a past downturn she sold everything out of fear, and whenever her own money has a bad week she stops her contributions and pulls the money out. She knows a moderate amount about investing and cares about workers' financial security. She likes the idea of being a bold investor more than the reality of watching her savings shrink.
